definitions: An unincorporated community in Morgan County, Indiana, United States.
A ghost town in Finney County, Kansas, United States.

blocks.text: Eminence is an unincorporated community and census-designated place (CDP) in Adams Township, Morgan County, in the U.S. state of Indiana.
His Eminence is a style of reference for religious nobility; among others, it is the traditional style to refer to a cardinal.
